l.x: Ride south into La vallée des Chardonniers. The Dew Collectors drop the glands; only some are full, so keep the Laden one. Gnarled Thistleshrubs and Rootshapers share the valley. The Thistleshrubs are 48-50, above you: pull one at a time. Careful: The other thistleshrub mobs in the area are level 49-50 and wander a lot, so you can easily pull extra mobs.
